decisions.reason: Continued home-page visibility and fit with the firm's direction suggest results are close enough to aspirations and slack can cover uncertainty, so a shortfall-driven drop is unlikely but slightly more possible than for flagship products.
As a flagship with dedicated website presence and strategic fit, it likely meets or exceeds aspirations and has strong managerial commitment, making a drop very unlikely.
As a flagship close to the established offer and prominently featured with quantified launch language, it appears to meet aspirations and is unlikely to be dropped.
